newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land sets two bln peso 5-yr paper.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land sets two bln peso 5-yr paper.

text.p: Ayala Land Inc said on Thursday it had offered two billion pesos worth of five-year floating rate commercial paper to finance its land banking and development projects in the countryside.
Ayala Land said the paper is repriceable and payable every quarter. Other details were not immediately available.
"They are redeemable at par value or 100 percent of principal after five years from the issue date," the statement said.
The issue was lead underwritten by AB Capital & Investment Corp and BPI Capital Corp.
